children: APPlife Digital Solutions entered into a securities purchase agreement with 104 and issued a $60,000 unsecured convertible note for a purchase price of $54,000. After fees and other costs, the company received $46,720, which it plans to use for business development and general working capital. The note matures October 22, 2027, carries a one-time 12% interest charge, and may be converted into common shares at a variable discount to the stock's recent trading price.
: Fund business development and general working capital
